repos = github.search_repositories(query="agent framework", limit=15)
details = map(repos, github.get_repository(full_name=_.full_name))
ratio = compute(details, ratio="forks / stars")
high = select(ratio, "ratio > 0.15")
low = select(ratio, "ratio <= 0.15")
contrib = map(high, github.get_contributor_stats(full_name=_.full_name))
commits = map(low, github.list_commits(full_name=_.full_name))
merged = join(ratio, contrib, commits, key="full_name")
kept = select(merged, "score >= 100")
sorted = sort(kept, key="score", desc=true)
top = take(sorted, 3)
return top

repos = github.search_repositories(query="agent framework", limit=30)
details = map(repos, github.get_repository(full_name=_.full_name))
scored = compute(details, ratio="forks / stars")
contrib = filter(scored, ratio="0") 
branch_high = select(scored, "ratio > 0.15")
branch_low = select(scored, "ratio <= 0.15")
contributors = map(branch_high, github.get_contributor_stats(full_name=_.full_name))
commits = map(branch_low, github.list_commits(full_name=_.full_name))
merged = join(details, contributors, commits, key="full_name")
kept = select(merged, "score >= 100")
sorted = sort(kept, key="score", desc=true)
top = take(sorted, 3)
return top
